papers.title: Observed-data distributions and partial identification of signed beyond-FLRW functionals
papers.question: Posterior/identified sets of x_C, Q, F, Pi(t), G_F conditioned on actual joint observation law
papers.estimands: Signed x_C (same-frame Gauss budget); Q=x_C/U with typed positive anchor; F samplewise only in admissible sign-clean sector; Pi strict threshold with unknown-mass interval; G_F depth-bin floor-stabilized ratio
papers.minimum_publishable_result: A real data-linked partially identified distribution + sensitivity across denominator/selection assumptions, or a calibrated posterior. No mere mathematical restatement.
papers.existing_evidence: PR066; PR521; MIO/HTT firewall; CF4/Planck real conditional data
papers.principal_blocker: Physical signed x_C has no fully identified common-congruence posterior and no certified total-x anchor
papers.submission_gate: Independent methods and partial-identification comparator; heldout or coverage; actual selected data law; nontrivial real-data figure

papers.title: Discriminating observer boosts, local bulk flows and global tilt using common response models

papers.title: Bianchi observable-equivalence and family identification with CMB T/E/B
